build_Reassemble_module: build a Reassemble module that reads transformer tokens, rearranges to spatial shape, and resamples feature maps
create_Resample_layer: create a Resample layer that projects and upsamples or downsamples 2D feature maps by a given scale factor
create_Read_projection_readout: create a Read_projection readout head that concatenates class token with patch tokens and projects through a linear layer
create_Read_add_readout: create a Read_add readout head that adds the class token to all patch tokens before returning
create_Read_ignore_readout: create a Read_ignore readout head that drops the class token and returns only patch tokens
